summary: Iteration 2 focused on the NEW features (weekly recap, free-text AI txn, itemized receipt endpoint, net-worth history chart, first-run onboarding gate) plus regressions. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py — 7/7 tests pass (parse-transaction happy+empty+unauth, weekly-recap fetch+cache+refresh, networth history, complete-onboarding, scan-receipt items). Frontend playwright with session cookies: dashboard renders net-worth-card+health-score-widget+weekly-recap-card, weekly recap loads real Bahasa Indonesia content (473 chars) and recap-refresh-button works, quick-add-ai-text → ai-text-input → ai-parse-button parses 'isi bensin bp 92 400k pakai debit ocbc' correctly (amount=400000, category=Transportasi, wallet auto-matched to wal_ocbctest 'OCBC Debit'), txn-save-button approves and OCBC Debit wallet balance decreases by exactly 400000, Reports page shows networth-history-chart, brand-new user (onboarded=false, cookie=test_session_new_002) redirects /dashboard → /budget wizard with budget-income-input + skip-onboarding-button visible; clicking skip calls /auth/complete-onboarding (user.onboarded flips to true) and navigates back to /dashboard, scan-receipt modal opens (itemize-toggle appears post-scan by code inspection; backend endpoint verified with items array). Old iteration-1 pytest suite still passes.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js WeeklyRecap: useEffect has empty deps and does not react to `version` from RefreshContext — the weekly recap won't refetch when other pages bump version (minor; explicit refresh button exists).
routes_ai.weekly_recap: cache key is ISO week only, no invalidation when new txns are added mid-week — user must click refresh to see updated recap (acceptable but worth documenting).

App.js Shell onboarding gate at line 83 relies on localStorage flag `nusa-skip-onboarding`; if a user clears storage after skipping and their DB flag onboarded=true, they still won't get redirected (correct because DB flag wins). BUT the initial skipOnboarding path in Budget.js also writes localStorage first and then awaits `complete-onboarding` — if the API call fails silently, DB stays onboarded=false but user proceeds. Add error toast on failure.

AddTransactionModal.save() posts wallet_id from state without re-checking membership after list refresh — low risk, but if user parses AI then wallets list mutates in another tab, could send stale id.

Reports.js networth-history-chart is conditionally rendered only when `hasNet` — a first-run user with zero snapshots will see nothing there (no explicit empty-state on that specific card). Consider EmptyState when net.length===0.
